captcha.error: Human verification failed. Please try again.
captcha.waiting: Complete human verification to enable account submission. If it does not load, allow challenges.cloudflare.com in your browser.

errors.generic: Could not authenticate. Check your details and try again.
errors.otpInvalid: That code is invalid or expired. Try again.
errors.otpSend: Could not send a verification code. Try again.
errors.twoFactorInvalid: That code is invalid. Try again.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.passwordResetFailed: Could not reset your password. Try again.
errors.passwordTooLong: Password must be no longer than 128 characters.
errors.accountExists: An account already exists for this email. Sign in, or reset your password.
errors.captchaFailed: Human verification failed. Complete it again and retry.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.serviceUnavailable: The authentication service is unavailable. Check the API terminal and try again.
errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect. If signup has not been completed, choose Create an account.
errors.invalidOrigin: Open Raahi at {{origin}} and try again. This browser address is not allowed for authentication.
errors.createFailed: The server could not create your account. Check the API terminal for the error.
errors.connection: Could not reach Raahi. Open {{origin}} and check that pnpm dev is still running.
errors.providerUnavailable: This sign-in provider is not configured. Use email and password.
